Transform your workflow with PromptKit—your all-in-one AI solution. Discover a curated prompt library for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and more. Instantly generate and use high-quality prompts with multiple AI models, or customize prompt templates designed to supercharge your productivity.

Create AI Prompts
Generate personalized, AI-powered prompts tailored to your specific needs, optimized for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other popular AI tools.

Use Prompts
Apply your prompts across multiple AI models to compare and test results.

Explore Templates
Browse through a curated library of high-quality prompts designed for various AI tools. Find inspiration and effective prompts for any task or project.

Organize Your Library
Save, categorize, and organize prompts into collections. Add favorites, keywords, and notes to build your personal AI library and streamline your workflow.

One-Click Copy
Instantly copy any prompt to your clipboard for immediate use with your favorite AI tools.

Share Prompts
Easily share your best prompts with colleagues, friends, or the community.

Save Favorites
Bookmark your most effective prompts for quick access whenever you need them.

Customize
Add keywords, categories, and notes to make your prompts more effective and easier to find.

Enhance Prompts
Effortlessly upgrade your saved prompts with the Enhance feature. Instantly refine, rewrite, or expand any prompt using AI—just describe what you need and let PromptKit perfect your AI prompts for even better results.

Designed for anyone seeking to get the most out of AI, PromptKit helps you harness Artificial Intelligence more effectively. Browse, create, and manage your prompts in seconds—become an AI Pro! Download PromptKit now to boost your productivity.

You can manage your subscription and cancel it at any time via your Apple ID Account Settings.

Whether you're planning a complete pool remodel, designing your dream resort-style oasis, upgrading your patio with luxurious water features, or exploring outdoor living ideas — our powerful AI makes it fast, easy, and truly inspiring.

Upload your outdoor photo and instantly see it reimagined with pools, hot tubs, custom decks, and elegant water features.

Perfect For:
• Homeowners planning backyard renovations

Download AI Pool Design now to start visualizing the perfect pool and outdoor space tailored just for you.

Create your personal oasis in just a few taps.

AI Home is your comprehensive solution for reimagining interiors, exteriors, gardens, and landscapes through advanced artificial intelligence. Whether you are revitalizing a single room, planning a garden upgrade, or envisioning an entirely new outdoor layout, AI Home makes it effortless to bring your ideas to life using just a photo.

 • AI Interior Design & Room Makeovers
Upload a photo of your room, select the space type, preferred style, and color scheme, and let our advanced AI technology handle the rest. The system carefully analyzes your room’s dimensions and visual characteristics to generate an elegant, fully realized interior design concept tailored to your preferences. Explore diverse styles, refined furniture layouts, harmonious color palettes, and thoughtfully curated decorative elements that elevate your space with a personalized touch.

 • AI Exterior Design & Renovation
Refresh your home’s exterior with confidence and ease. Simply upload an image of your house and select your preferred aesthetic. The app generates a customized renovation concept, allowing you to preview updated materials, coordinated color selections, and architectural enhancements before making any real-world changes.

 • AI Landscape Design
Shape your outdoor environment with intelligent landscape planning. Whether it’s a front yard, backyard, or expansive open space, the AI analyzes your surroundings and presents structured, harmonious landscape layouts featuring pathways, planting zones, water features, and ambient lighting concepts.

Design the garden you’ve always imagined. Upload a photo of your yard, balcony, terrace, or rooftop, and let the AI craft a tailored garden layout. Discover plant combinations, seating arrangements, walkway designs, and thematic styles — from tropical retreats to serene minimalist gardens — perfectly suited to your available space.

 • AI Replace – Transform Any Item
Easily modify your environment with the AI Replace feature. Remove unwanted furniture or decor and replace them with alternative items to see how different pieces, shapes, and styles elevate your space. Create polished, realistic previews instantly and seamlessly.

 • AI Upscale – Enhance Photo Quality Elegantly
Elevate the clarity and detail of your images with the AI Upscale feature. Instantly transform low-resolution or blurry photos into sharp, elegant, high-quality visuals. Whether you are improving old room photos, enhancing renovation snapshots, or refining design previews, AI Upscale ensures every image looks crisp, refined, and professionally polished.

Browse a curated collection of design concepts for interiors and exteriors. Whether you seek subtle inspiration or a complete transformation, AI Home provides endless ideas to guide your creative journey.
